clips.title: The story
paras: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker trains champions of the Light. A veteran paladin commander of the Knights of the Silver Hand, he guides promising knights and oversees the sacred trials senior paladins must complete to claim their holy chargers.

Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker leads the Silver Hand's work in Stormwind City and ranks among the Alliance's foremost defenders. A veteran of the order, he trains recruits in arms and tests their faith in the Light. When promising knights are ready, he sends them north to the contested front lines of the Western Plaguelands. There, they aid Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.
